sections.title: Day 16 學習概覽
sections.markdown:
今天承接 Day 15，正式加強 **Part 3 職業／地點／下一步推論**；文法主題是 TOEIC Part 5 高頻的 **數量詞 `few / a few / little / a little / many / much / several / each / every`**。

目前沒有收到 Day 15 的實際小考成績，因此今天維持 **860～900 分難度**。從今天開始 Listening 題會減少「原句照抄」，增加同義改寫與推論。建議訓練約 **90～100 分鐘**。

sections.title: ② 今日文法｜many vs. much
sections.markdown:
最基本的判斷：

> **many + 可數複數**

例如：

> many customers  
> many products  
> many employees

而：

> **much + 不可數名詞**

例如：

> much information  
> much time  
> much money

因此：

> We don't have _____ information about the problem.

(A) many  
(B) much

答案：

**B**

`information` 是不可數名詞。

不要寫：

> informations ❌

---

sections.title: ③ few vs. a few
sections.markdown:
兩個後面都是：

> **可數複數**

但是語意不同。

### few

> Few customers complained.

= 幾乎沒有顧客抱怨。

帶有：

**不足／很少**

的語氣。

### a few

> A few customers complained.

= 有幾位顧客抱怨。

雖然不多，但：

**還是有一些。**

因此可以簡化成：

> few = 幾乎沒有

> a few = 有一些

---

sections.title: ④ little vs. a little
sections.markdown:
對應不可數名詞。

### little

> We have little time.

= 幾乎沒時間。

### a little

> We have a little time.

= 還有一點時間。

所以：

| 可數 | 不可數 |
|---|---|
| few | little |
| a few | a little |

---

sections.title: ⑤ several
sections.markdown:
> **several + 可數複數**

例如：

> several customers

> several complaints

意思大約是：

**數個、幾個**

通常比 `a few` 更中性。

---

sections.title: ⑥ each vs. every
sections.markdown:
這是 TOEIC 很常考的地方。

兩者後面通常都接：

> **單數可數名詞**

例如：

> each employee

> every employee

所以：

> Every employees ❌

應該是：

> Every employee ✅

---

### each

強調：

**一個一個個別看**

例如：

> Each employee received a badge.

---

### every

強調：

**整個群體中的每一個**

> Every employee must attend the meeting.

考試最重要的是：

> **each/every + singular noun**

---

sections.title: ⑦ each of
sections.markdown:
但注意：

> each of + 複數名詞／代名詞

例如：

> each of the employees

而動詞通常仍視為單數：

> Each of the employees **is** required to attend.

這是 860+ 常見陷阱。

---

sections.title: ⑧ 數量詞秒判表
sections.markdown:
| 數量詞 | 後面 |
|---|---|
| many | 可數複數 |
| much | 不可數 |
| few | 可數複數 |
| a few | 可數複數 |
| little | 不可數 |
| a little | 不可數 |
| several | 可數複數 |
| each | 單數 |
| every | 單數 |
| each of | 複數 |

看到數量詞題，第一步：

> **先看名詞可數還是不可數。**

不要先翻譯。

---

sections.title: ⑨ Part 3｜今天的解題升級
sections.markdown:
Day 15 練：

> 問題 → 解決方案 → 下一步

今天加入三種推論：

**Where are the speakers?**

→ 地點。

**Who most likely is the speaker?**

→ 職業／角色。

**What will the speaker probably do next?**

→ 下一步。

這些答案通常不會直接講出來。

例如聽到：

> Your room is ready, and here's your key card.

不用聽到：

> We are in a hotel.

也能推論：

**hotel front desk**

---

sections.title: ⑩ Listening｜Part 3 對話一
sections.markdown:
先讀題目。

### Q1

Where most likely are the speakers?

(A) At a hotel  
(B) At a bank  
(C) At a restaurant  
(D) At a factory

### Q2

What problem does the woman mention?

(A) Her room is too small  
(B) Her reservation cannot be found  
(C) Her luggage is damaged  
(D) Her payment was declined

### Q3

What will the man probably do next?

(A) Contact a manager  
(B) Check another system  
(C) Carry some luggage  
(D) Issue a refund

聽力稿：

> **Woman:** Hi, I have a reservation under the name Chen, but I don't see it listed on the check-in screen.
>
> **Man:** Let me take a look. What date did you make the reservation?
>
> **Woman:** About three weeks ago through your website.
>
> **Man:** I see. Our online reservations are stored in a separate system. Let me check that for you.

答案：

**1A / 2B / 3B**

Q1 沒有人說：

> hotel

但是：

> reservation  
> check-in

足以推論。

Q3：

> Let me check that for you.

就是：

**下一步行動。**

---

sections.title: ⑪ Listening｜Part 3 對話二
sections.markdown:
### Q1

Who most likely is the man?

(A) A customer  
(B) A repair technician  
(C) A salesperson  
(D) An accountant

### Q2

What problem is mentioned?

(A) A product is unavailable  
(B) A machine is not operating correctly  
(C) An invoice is incorrect  
(D) A delivery is late

### Q3

What does the man request?

(A) A receipt  
(B) A replacement part  
(C) An instruction manual  
(D) A warranty extension

聽力稿：

> **Woman:** Thanks for coming. The copier has been making a strange noise, and sometimes it stops in the middle of a print job.
>
> **Man:** I'll take a look. This model sometimes has problems with its paper-feed mechanism.
>
> **Woman:** Do you think you can repair it today?
>
> **Man:** Probably, but I'll need to see the machine's service record first.

答案：

**1B / 2B / 3A**

Q3 要稍微推論。

他要：

> service record

選項沒有 service record。

最接近可作為設備維修紀錄／購買服務資訊的選項是 `receipt`，但這題的選項設計不夠精確；正式練習時應避免把「service record」硬改成 receipt。這題請以 **Listening 推論示範**為主，不計入今天正式小考。

---

sections.title: ⑫ Listening｜Part 3 對話三
sections.markdown:
### Q1

What are the speakers discussing?

(A) A customer complaint  
(B) A job interview  
(C) A marketing campaign  
(D) An expense report

### Q2

Why is the customer dissatisfied?

(A) A product arrived damaged  
(B) The price increased  
(C) A refund was denied  
(D) A shipment arrived early

### Q3

What will the woman probably do?

(A) Contact the delivery company  
(B) Place another order  
(C) Change the product price  
(D) Cancel the warranty

聽力稿：

> **Man:** We received another complaint about damaged packaging this morning.
>
> **Woman:** Was it from the same delivery company we've been using?
>
> **Man:** Yes. The product itself was fine, but the customer was unhappy with the condition of the box.
>
> **Woman:** That's the third complaint this week. I'll call the delivery company this afternoon.

答案：

**1A / 2A / 3A**

注意 Q2：

產品本身：

> was fine

問題是：

> damaged packaging

因此不要聽到 product 就誤選產品故障。

---

sections.title: ⑬ Reading｜Part 7
sections.markdown:
今天限時：

**3 分 30 秒。**

> **CUSTOMER SERVICE NOTICE**
>
> Customers who are dissatisfied with a purchase may return most unused products within 30 days. Each returned product must include its original packaging and proof of purchase.
>
> A full refund will be issued to the original payment method once the returned product has been inspected. Customers should allow three to five business days for the refund to appear in their account.
>
> A few products, including customized items and opened software packages, are not eligible for refunds. However, defective products covered by the manufacturer's warranty may be exchanged for replacement products.
>
> Customers who purchased products through one of our retail locations should return them to the same location. Online purchases may be returned by mail using the prepaid shipping label available on our website.
>
> For additional assistance, please contact a customer service representative.

### Q1

How long do customers generally have to return a product?

(A) 5 days  
(B) 14 days  
(C) 30 days  
(D) 60 days

### Q2

What must accompany a returned product?

(A) A warranty extension  
(B) Original packaging and proof of purchase  
(C) A customer survey  
(D) A new order

### Q3

When will a refund be issued?

(A) Before the product is returned  
(B) Once the product is inspected  
(C) After 30 business days  
(D) When another product is purchased

### Q4

Which products may not qualify for refunds?

(A) All online purchases  
(B) Customized items  
(C) Products purchased in stores  
(D) Unopened products

### Q5

What may happen to a defective product under warranty?

(A) It may be exchanged  
(B) It must be repaired by the customer  
(C) It will receive a larger discount  
(D) It cannot be returned

### Q6

How can an online customer return a product?

(A) Only at a retail store  
(B) By contacting the manufacturer  
(C) By mail  
(D) Through a salesperson

### Q7

The phrase **“A few products”** indicates that:

(A) no products are excluded  
(B) a small number of products are excluded  
(C) almost every product is excluded  
(D) exactly two products are excluded

答案：

**1C / 2B / 3B / 4B / 5A / 6C / 7B**

Q7 就是今天文法直接進入閱讀理解：

> a few

= 有一些，數量不多。

sections.title: ⑯ 今日解析
sections.markdown:
Q2：

> information

不可數。

選項中：

> little information

正確。

`few information` 不成立。

---

Q3：

> so we can review the slides

表示：

「還有一些時間。」

所以：

> **a little time**

如果是：

> We have little time, so let's hurry.

則是：

**幾乎沒時間。**

這個語意差異很常考。

---

Q5：

> Each of the products _____ inspected

真正主詞是：

> **Each**

單數。

所以：

> **is inspected**

而且 product 是被 inspect：

**被動。**

這題同時回收 Day 5 的被動語態。

---

sections.title: ⑱ 今日作業
sections.markdown:
今天先把數量詞做成兩組記憶：

> **可數：many / few / a few / several**

> **不可數：much / little / a little**

另外單獨記：

> **each + 單數**

> **every + 單數**

> **each of + 複數名詞 + 單數動詞**

再朗讀：

> Few customers complained.  
> A few customers complained.

以及：

> We have little time.  
> We have a little time.

務必理解兩組語意差異，而不是只背形式。

Listening 作業則把今天三段對話只壓縮成：

> **D1：hotel → reservation missing → check separate system**

> **D2：copier problem → technician → check service record**

> **D3：complaint → damaged packaging → call delivery company**

Part 3 筆記開始強制限制在 **3 個資訊點**，訓練自己不要試圖記住整段英文。

最後重新完成 Day 16 小考，第二次限制 **2 分 30 秒**，目標 **10/10**。

如果今天達到 **9～10/10**，Day 17 的 Part 3 會加入更難的 **意圖推論（What does the speaker imply?）**；若 Listening 四題錯兩題以上，則維持職業／地點／下一步題型再鞏固一天。

**Day 16 核心：Part 3 不需要聽到 `hotel` 才知道人在飯店。真正的高分能力，是從 `reservation / check-in / key card` 這些線索推論情境。**

Day 17 將進入 **Part 3 意圖與暗示推論 + 不定代名詞 `someone / anyone / everyone / no one / something / anything`**，並開始把 Listening 的答案改寫幅度再提高一級。
